claim.claim-text: 1. An authentication method for a satellite-based navigation system (100), SNS, comprising:

2. The authentication method of claim 1, wherein the validation filter is generated by the authentication server (160) based on at least some hashes contained in message authentication bundles obtained from a plurality of reference receiver stations (130).
3. The authentication method of claim 2, wherein generating the validation filter by the authentication server (160) comprises:
- inserting (206), by the authentication server (160), at least a subset of the hashes comprised in the obtained message authentication bundles into the PDS.

4. The authentication method of claim 3, wherein, in the step of inserting (206) at least a subset of the hashes into the PDS, only hashes consistently received in a majority of the obtained message authentication bundles received from the plurality of reference receiver stations (130) that exceeds a predefined quorum are inserted by the authentication server (160) into the PDS.

5. The authentication method of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the validation filter is distributed from the authentication server (160) to the receiver-side device (140) at the end of a predetermined authentication interval.

6. The authentication method of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the validation filter is transmitted from the authentication server (160) to the receiver-side device (140) by a wired or wireless data network either directly or using a content distribution network.

7. The authentication method of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the validation filter is feed from the authentication server (160) to a satellite for broadcasting the filter to the receiver-side device (140), in particularly using an auxiliary, fixed bandwidth transmission channel of a navigation satellite (110) of the SNS system (100).
8. The authentication method of any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the PDS has a fixed size.

9. The authentication method of claim 8, wherein the PDS is implemented as a Cuckoo filter (510), the Cuckoo filter (510) comprises m buckets, each bucket has b entries, and each entry has a length of f bits, wherein m, b and f are positive integers.

10. The authentication method of any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the validation filter further comprises a stash list (520) and the step of querying the validation filter by the receiver-side device (140) further comprises:

- in case querying the PDS indicates that a given hash could not have been inserted successfully into the PDS, querying, by the receiver side-device (140), the stash list (520) to verify if the given hash could have been inserted into the stash list (520).
11. The authentication method of claim 10, wherein the stash list (520) has a fixed length and comprises s elements, wherein each element has a length of e bits, and s and e are positive integers.

12. The authentication method of claims 9 and 11, wherein entries of the entries of the Cuckoo filter (510) comprise fingerprints of f bits of respective hashes, and the entries of the stash list (520) comprise fingerprints of e bits of respective hashes, wherein e is larger than f.

13. The authentication method of any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the validation filter is transmitted from the authentication server (160) to the receiver-side device (140) as part of an authentication message, wherein the authentication message further comprises a digital signature generated by the authentication server (160) to ensure the authenticity of the authentication message and/or wherein the authentication message is transmitted using a secure channel ensuring the authenticity of the authentication message.
14. A receiver-side device apparatus (700), comprising

15. An authentication system (900) for a satellite-based navigation system (100), SNS, the authentication system (900) comprising a plurality of reference receiver stations (130), an authentication server (160) and at least one receiver-side device (140), wherein

- the authentication server (160) is configured to perform the following steps: - insert (206) at least a subset of the hashes comprised in the obtained message authentication bundles into a probabilistic data structure, PDS, which forms at least a part of a validation filter for authenticating a corresponding subset of SNS messages; and - distributing (207) the validation filter to at least one receiver-side device (140); and
- the at least one receiver side-device (130) is configured to perform the steps of the method according to one of claims 1 to 13.
